462:t_012:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「All right! We've broken through 50% of the target amount!」

462:t_013:0.en:
$$木下$$
「You did it, President! Team 'Salaryman' has broken through 50000 in earned funds!」

462:t_013:3.en:
$$青山$$
「Once again we're shown the difference in caliber between a president and a mere salaryman...」

462:t_013:4.en:
$$いぶき$$
「I wonder how far $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ will have grown by the time $$ワッ太$$ is an adult.」

462:t_013:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You sure about that, $$いぶき$$? Talk like that and I'll merge $$２１世紀警備保障$$ into my company!」

462:t_013:6.en:
$$赤木$$
「Talk about the underling toppling the boss!」

462:t_013:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「As long as I've got all my employees and $$トライダー$$, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ will live forever!」

462:t_014:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's our custom $$グレートノットパニッシャー$$ for you! What incredible penetrating power!」

462:t_014:1.en:
$$青山$$
「Modifying it was worth it, even if it put us deep in the red.」

462:t_014:2.en:
$$いぶき$$
「That'll give us something to brag about when we meet $$シャッコ$$.」

462:t_100:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's do it, $$赤木$$! Earth's peace and our company's coffers are both important!」

462:t_100:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Understood, President $$ワッ太$$! Our company will also go all out to meet the budget!」

462:t_100:2.en:
$$いぶき$$
「It's a perfect picture of who gives the orders and who takes them...」

462:t_100:3.en:
$$青山$$
「Really... $$ワッ太$$ is going to be terrifying when he grows up.」

462:t_101:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Like I'd lose to you...! I won't lose!」

462:t_101:1.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Why...? Why do you fight while enduring fear?」

462:t_101:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll tell you, $$ガイゾック$$! It's because I'm human!」

462:t_101:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's not about logic! I fight to protect what's precious to me! No matter how much it hurts, no matter how scary it is!!」

462:t_102:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Humans must not be allowed to use the power of $$ガバールニウム$$.」

462:t_102:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are you talking about! My $$トライダー$$ was built by Uncle $$梅本$$ as proof of his friendship with my dad!」

462:t_102:2.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Humans use that power for evil.」

462:t_102:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then there's nothing to worry about. I'll use $$トライダー$$'s power for what's right.」

462:t_102:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Fighting you is one of those things! Let's go, you broken computer!!」

462:t_103:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「I see... So you despaired of humanity too.」

462:t_103:1.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Since the moment of my birth, I have never expected anything of humans.」

462:t_103:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Then we'll teach you how wonderful life is. By defeating a machine bound by its ego with love, courage and power!」

462:t_103:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「That is exactly what makes us human!」

462:t_103:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me! $$勝平$$'s moonlight and my sun will smash your darkness!」

462:t_104:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Did you drive $$シグマ$$, the mother computer of $$ガバール星$$, insane!?」

462:t_104:1.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「It is the humans who are warped. I will eliminate them from the universe.」

462:t_104:2.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I will manage your robot as well. Hand over the power of that sun.」

462:t_104:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Not a chance! $$鉄人$$ is a real robot that fights alongside me!」

462:t_104:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I won't lose! For $$梅本$$'s sake too, we'll defeat you!」

462:t_105:0.en:
$n
($$蒼の地球$$ after so long... Japan...)

462:t_105:1.en:
$n
(Miss $$スズネ$$, $$マキ#pilot$$... everyone at $$陣代高校$$...)

462:t_105:2.en:
$n
(If I can never go back to the past, all I can do is move forward...!)

462:t_105:3.en:
$n
(And I'll protect them... everything that's precious to me!)
